meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: Claude 会接入 GitHub:在 PR(拉取请求)和 issue 的评论线程里参与对话。有人 @ 机器人账号后它开始回复,之后该线程的后续评论它都会跟进。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人账号时触发;首次提及后该线程的后续评论也会接管。仓库 webhook 需订阅 issue 评论、PR review 评论等事件。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 渠道接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会从 channels 分支拷贝 GitHub 适配器并注册

say.text: 新建一个监控 github:acme/backend 的 GitHub 消息组
say.note: 用 ncl 创建消息组,再用 per-thread 模式接线

say.text: 这是公开仓库,请用 strict 的 unknown_sender_policy
say.note: 只有已注册成员能触发 agent

howto.what_en: Claude gains a GitHub channel: it takes part in pull request and issue comment threads. After someone @-mentions the bot account it replies, then follows all later comments in that thread.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment; after that, the thread is subscribed and later comments are handled. Webhooks must cover issue and PR review comments.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel to my NanoClaw project
say_en.note: Copies the GitHub adapter from the channels branch and registers it

say_en.text: Create a GitHub messaging group for github:acme/backend
say_en.note: Creates the group with ncl and wires it to an agent group

say_en.text: Use strict unknown_sender_policy since this repo is public
say_en.note: Only registered members can trigger the agent
